_comment: Which edit classes Quick Fix may apply silently. silent = replaced without asking; review_only = shown in the Review panel first; off = never produced. A class is silent only where the gate set (bench/typed_gate.jsonl, scored by bench/score_typed.py) shows G1, G2 and G5 within target; 'gate' records that run. 'contexts' caps every class in an app category (the lowest of the two wins).
